integrity: The local stochastic comparison is proved by coupling the two possible parent choices of one arrival while keeping every other parent variable fixed. The path-length difference is exactly the final subtree size times the alternative parent's depth. The covariance profile follows from its expectation, and exhaustive parent-sequence enumeration independently replays the finite identities.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas use uniform recursive-tree attachment and need not persist under preferential or deterministic label weights.
The monotone-transform statement concerns covariance with root degree; it does not claim negative association for the full tree-statistic vector.
Older increasing-tree literature may contain an equivalent mixed root-degree/path-length moment under a different generating-function encoding.
title: Root attachments have an exact negative path-length profile in random recursive trees
